purpose: Qualify a CPU host before MP-B01 performance deltas may be treated as a CPU baseline.

preflight.selection_rule: Select the non-throttled CPU with the lowest child-process CPU-time coefficient of variation; break ties by CPU id.

pilot.use: Estimate paired child-CPU standard deviation only.

final.paired_order: alternate off/on and on/off by cycle

hard_gates: deterministic CPU selection follows preflight rule
physical output hashes are identical across measured variants
no cgroup throttling in measured samples
no cgroup throttling anywhere in the qualification window
final child-CPU minimum detectable relative effect <= 1%
admission_rule: All hard gates must pass. Failure establishes no CPU baseline and must not be repaired by adding post-hoc pairs to the same experiment.
